title: Gemini AI Gateway chat responses (GeminiAdapter): detect tool calls by any functionCall part, not parts[0], and keep sibling text as message content
answers: Gateway Gemini chat response dropped my tool call when the model wrote text before the function call
AI Gateway returns a 500 KeyError 'functionCall' when a Gemini candidate has text and a function call together
Where is the Gemini candidate-to-OpenAI tool_calls conversion handled in the gateway?
Streaming Gemini chat through the gateway: how are text and tool calls combined into one delta?
body:
Path: Gemini generateContent responses (chat and streaming) returned through the AI Gateway, including Vertex AI which inherits the same adapter. Chokepoints are mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat and GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat_streaming, which pick the tool-call path, and GeminiAdapter._convert_function_call_to_openai_choice, which builds the OpenAI-style message or stream delta.
Rule: Choose the tool-call branch with `any(part.get("functionCall") for part in parts)`, never by inspecting `parts[0]`. Inside _convert_function_call_to_openai_choice, skip parts without a `functionCall`, collect every `text` part into one string, and set `content` to that joined string (or None when empty) alongside `tool_calls` on both the message and the stream delta. Text-only candidates still take the original text path.
Symptom: When Gemini put text before a functionCall, the tool call was silently dropped and the user got a plain text reply with no tool_calls. When the functionCall came first, the gateway raised KeyError 'functionCall' and returned a server error. A text part placed after the call was also lost.
Constraints: Applies to candidate parts in the Gemini response format only; request-side conversion of assistant tool_calls is a separate path. Parts that have neither text nor functionCall (e.g. thoughtSignature-only parts) are ignored by the loop. Covered by tests/gateway/providers/test_gemini.py:test_gemini_chat_mixed_text_and_function_call_parts and test_gemini_chat_streaming_mixed_text_and_function_call_parts, parametrized on text-then-call and call-then-text.
applies: Gateway Gemini response conversion (mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py) for any candidate mixing text and functionCall parts, including the Vertex AI adapter that inherits these methods.
says: Tool calls are dropped when the model returns text before calling a tool.
Gateway chat throws an internal server error when responses combine text with tools.
Chat responses lose the accompanying text explanation when the model triggers a tool.
Streaming chat fails to deliver tool calls if the model outputs text first.
Ensure both text explanations and tool calls appear in gateway chat replies.
search: In mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py, GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat and model_to_chat_streaming must detect tool calls using `any(part.get('functionCall') for part in parts)` rather than checking `parts[0]`. In GeminiAdapter._convert_function_call_to_openai_choice, parts without functionCall are skipped, all text parts are combined into content alongside tool_calls on messages and stream deltas, and parts lacking text or functionCall like thoughtSignature are ignored. Without this, placing text before functionCall drops the tool call, placing functionCall first causes a KeyError and 500 server error, and trailing text is discarded. This rule applies to Gemini and Vertex AI response conversions for chat and streaming chat, but excludes request-side assistant tool call conversion.
